concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-010 (implement Phylogenetic Generalized Least Squares) is not covered by any task. The spec explicitly mandates PGLS as the primary regression model, but the task list only mentions Random Forest, Elastic Net, and Gradient Boosting. This omission weakens the functional requirement.

Success Criterion SC-004 (alignment success rate against the input list) is not explicitly verified. T009’s verification references FR-004 but does not state that the alignment success rate is checked against SC-004. The acceptance criterion is therefore dropped.

Functional Requirement FR-006 requires evaluation on a hold‑out test set. T012’s verification mentions model metrics and permutation baseline but does not confirm that a separate hold‑out set is used. The acceptance scenario is thus not fully satisfied.
